ICLR 2025 · MRI RECONSTRUCTION / AMBIENT DIFFUSION

环境扩散后验采样：用受损数据训练的扩散模型求解逆问题

Ambient Diffusion Posterior Sampling: Solving Inverse Problems with Diffusion Models Trained on Corrupted Data

Asad Aali* · Giannis Daras* · Brett Levac · Sidharth Kumar · Alexandros G. Dimakis · Jonathan I. Tamir

很多场景拿不到完整采样的数据，只能拿到被线性算子破坏过的测量。这篇论文先把 Ambient Diffusion 推广到傅里叶域欠采样的多线圈 MRI，再用这些「只在受损数据上训练过」的模型，通过一个改写的 DPS 更新式，去解另一个前向算子下的逆问题。

这一段是译者注，不是原文。它只做一件事：让你在读到公式 (2.1)–(2.12) 时，知道每个量在做什么。

  1. 前向算子：测量写成 y=Axy=A xy=Ax，AAA 是已知的线性算子。MRI 里 AAA 由「线圈敏感度 SiS_iSi​ → 傅里叶变换 F\mathcal FF → 欠采样掩膜 PPP」复合而成，见公式 (2.5)。
  2. 两次受损：训练时原始数据已经被 AtrainA_{\mathrm{train}}Atrain​ 破坏一次；Ambient Diffusion 再人为破坏一次得到 A~train\tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}A~train​，并让网络从 y~\tilde yy~​ 预测未再破坏的 yyy。所以网络学到的是「给定更差的输入，如何回到稍好的测量」，而不是干净图像本身。
  3. 后验采样：推理时我们想从 p(x0∣yinf)p(x_0\mid y_{\mathrm{inf}})p(x0​∣yinf​) 采样，AinfA_{\mathrm{inf}}Ainf​ 可以和训练时的 AtrainA_{\mathrm{train}}Atrain​ 完全不同。DPS 用「网络估计的 E[x0∣xt]\mathbb E[x_0\mid x_t]E[x0​∣xt​]」加上「测量似然的梯度」来近似这个后验；A-DPS 只是把前者换成 ambient 版本 E[x0∣y~t,train,A~train]\mathbb E[x_0\mid \tilde y_{t,\mathrm{train}},\tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}]E[x0​∣y~​t,train​,A~train​]。
  4. 指标：NRMSE、SSIM、PSNR 是像素级重建指标；LPIPS、DISTS 是感知指标；FID 衡量生成分布与真实分布的差距。表中箭头表示越大越好还是越小越好。
术语速查（译者注）
k 空间
MRI 的原始测量空间，即图像的二维/三维傅里叶系数空间。采集一条「读出线」等于采一条 k 空间的竖线。
加速因子 RRR
R=n/mR=n/mR=n/m，nnn 是完整 k 空间系数个数，mmm 是实际测量个数。R=4R=4R=4 表示只采四分之一的线。
ACS 区域
k 空间中心的自校准信号区域，用于估计线圈敏感度；本文所有掩膜都保留中心 20 行。
Ambient score
Ambient Diffusion 学到的「给定进一步受损的测量与掩膜时的干净信号期望」，是本文一切推导的入口。
FS-DPS
用完整采样数据训练的模型跑原始 DPS，本文最主要的对照方法。
A-OS / A-ALD
同一个 Ambient 模型的两种用法：一步直接预测（A-OS）与退火朗之万动力学采样（A-ALD）。

摘要

English original
Abstract

我们给出一个框架，用于在只能从被线性破坏的数据中学习扩散模型的情况下求解逆问题。首先，我们把 Ambient Diffusion 框架推广到可以直接从傅里叶域受损的测量中训练；随后，我们只用加速度因子 R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8 的傅里叶欠采样多线圈测量，训练出用于 MRI 的扩散模型。其次，我们提出 Ambient Diffusion Posterior Sampling（A-DPS）：一种重建算法，它利用在某一类破坏（例如图像修补）上预训练的生成模型，对来自另一种前向过程（例如图像模糊）的测量做后验采样。在高加速的 MRI 重建中，我们观察到在欠采样数据上训练的 A-DPS 模型，比在完整采样数据上训练的模型更适合求解逆问题。我们还在自然图像数据集（CelebA、FFHQ 和 AFHQ）上验证了 A-DPS 的有效性，并表明在若干图像复原任务中，A-DPS 有时能在速度和性能两方面同时超过在干净数据上训练的模型。

English original
We provide a framework for solving inverse problems with diffusion models learned from linearly corrupted data. Firstly, we extend the Ambient Diffusion framework to enable training directly from measurements corrupted in the Fourier domain. Subsequently, we train diffusion models for MRI with access only to Fourier subsampled multi-coil measurements at acceleration factors R=2,4,6,8=2, 4, 6, 8=2,4,6,8. Secondly, we propose Ambient Diffusion Posterior Sampling (A-DPS), a reconstruction algorithm that leverages generative models pre-trained on one type of corruption (e.g. image inpainting) to perform posterior sampling on measurements from a different forward process (e.g. image blurring). For MRI reconstruction in high acceleration regimes, we observe that A-DPS models trained on subsampled data are better suited to solving inverse problems than models trained on fully sampled data. We also test the efficacy of A-DPS on natural image datasets (CelebA, FFHQ, and AFHQ) and show that A-DPS can sometimes outperform models trained on clean data for several image restoration tasks in both speed and performance.[1]

1 引言

English original
1 Introduction

在某些应用中，获取完整观测数据代价高昂甚至不可能 (Collaboration 等, 2019)、(Gao 等, 2023)、(Yaman 等, 2020)，但获取部分观测样本是可行的。此外，用受损数据训练生成模型可能更可取，因为这会减少对训练集的记忆 (Daras 等, 2023b)、(Carlini 等, 2023)、(Somepalli 等, 2022)。已有工作展示了如何用受损数据训练生成对抗网络（GAN）(Bora 等, 2018)、(Cole 等, 2021)、流模型 (Kelkar 等, 2023) 以及复原模型 (Lehtinen 等, 2018)、(Krull 等, 2019)、(Yaman 等, 2020)、(Millard & Chiew, 2023)。更近期，研究重心转向在给定受损数据的情况下训练扩散生成模型 (Daras 等, 2024)、(Daras 等, 2023a)、(Daras 等, 2023b)、(Aali 等, 2023)、(Kawar 等, 2023)、(Cui 等, 2022)、(Kim & Ye, 2021)。目前仍未被探索的是：在某一类破坏（例如修补过的数据）上训练出的生成模型，如何用来求解另一类前向过程（例如模糊）下的逆问题。

English original
For some applications, it is expensive or impossible to acquire fully observed data (Collaboration et al., 2019; Gao et al., 2023; Yaman et al., 2020) but possible to acquire partially observed samples. Furthermore, it may be desirable to train generative models with corrupted data since that reduces memorization of the training set (Daras et al., 2023b; Carlini et al., 2023; Somepalli et al., 2022). Prior works have shown how to train Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) (Bora et al., 2018; Cole et al., 2021), flow models (Kelkar et al., 2023) and restoration models (Lehtinen et al., 2018; Krull et al., 2019; Yaman et al., 2020; Millard & Chiew, 2023) with corrupted data. More recently, there has been a shift towards training diffusion generative models given corrupted data (Daras et al., 2024; Daras et al., 2023a; Daras et al., 2023b; Aali et al., 2023; Kawar et al., 2023; Cui et al., 2022; Kim & Ye, 2021). What remains unexplored is how generative models trained on a certain type of corruption (e.g. inpainted data) can be used to solve inverse problems with a different forward process (e.g. blurring).

我们提出首个用 Ambient Diffusion 模型 (Daras 等, 2023b) 求解逆问题的框架。这类模型只利用线性测量的访问权限来训练，估计的是 ambient score，也就是给定一个被受损线性前向算子作用过的受损含噪输入时，如何最好地重建。我们展示如何用这些模型在其训练分布之外求解线性逆问题。我们在自然图像和多线圈 MRI 数据集上的实验揭示了一件反直觉的事：在高破坏程度区间，Ambient 模型可以超过在干净数据上训练的模型，同时速度还快得多。我们的算法把 Diffusion Posterior Sampling (Chung 等, 2023) 推广到 Ambient Diffusion 模型。我们的贡献：[2]

English original
We propose the first framework to solve inverse problems with Ambient Diffusion models (Daras et al., 2023b). These models are trained using only access to linear measurements and they estimate the ambient score, i.e. how to best reconstruct given an input with a corrupted linear forward operator corrupted noisy input. We show how to use these models for solving linear inverse problems outside their training distribution. Our experiments on datasets of natural images and multi-coil MRI show something surprising: Ambient Models can outperform (in the high corruption regime) models trained on clean data while being substantially faster. Our algorithm extends Diffusion Posterior Sampling (Chung et al., 2023) to Ambient Diffusion models. Our contributions:

我们提出 Ambient Diffusion Posterior Sampling（Ambient DPS），一种把在线性受损数据上训练的扩散模型当作先验、来求解任意线性测量模型下逆问题的算法。

English original
We propose Ambient Diffusion Posterior Sampling (Ambient DPS), an algorithm that uses diffusion models trained on linearly corrupted data as priors for solving inverse problems with arbitrary linear measurement models.

我们扩展 Ambient Diffusion 框架，使其能用傅里叶欠采样测量训练。具体来说，我们在不同回顾性加速因子（R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8）的欠采样多线圈 MRI 扫描上训练；我们观察到，在欠采样数据上训练的模型，是求解高加速区间逆问题的更好先验。

English original
We extend the Ambient Diffusion framework to train models using Fourier subsampled measurements. Specifically, we train on subsampled multi-coil MRI scans at various retrospective acceleration factors (R=2,4,6,82, 4, 6, 82,4,6,8); we observe that models trained on subsampled data are better priors for solving inverse problems in the high acceleration regime.

我们用预训练的 Ambient Diffusion 模型，在自然图像数据集（CelebA、FFHQ、AFHQ）上求解逆问题（压缩感知、超分辨率），并表明它们在高破坏程度区间甚至可以超过在干净数据上训练的模型。

English original
We use pre-trained Ambient Diffusion models to solve inverse problems (compressed sensing, super-resolution) on natural image datasets (CelebA, FFHQ, AFHQ) and show that they can even outperform models trained on clean data in the high corruption regime.

2.1 Background and Notation

Diffusion Posterior Sampling（DPS）

English original
Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS).

扩散模型通常被训练为：从含噪观测 xt=x0+σtη, η∼N(0,I)\boldsymbol{x}_t = \boldsymbol{x}_0 + \sigma_t \boldsymbol{\eta},\ \boldsymbol{\eta} \sim \mathcal N(\boldsymbol{0}, I)xt​=x0​+σt​η, η∼N(0,I) 重建干净图像 x0∼p0(x0)\boldsymbol{x}_0 \sim p_0(\boldsymbol{x}_0)x0​∼p0​(x0​)。尽管训练目标很简单，扩散模型仍可以通过运行随机微分方程的离散化版本来近似地从 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 采样 (Song 等, 2020)、(Anderson, 1982)：

English original
Diffusion models are typically trained to reconstruct a clean image x0∼p0(x0)\boldsymbol{x}_0 \sim p_0(\boldsymbol{x}_0)x0​∼p0​(x0​) from a noisy observation xt=x0+σtη,η∼N(0,I)\boldsymbol{x}_t = \boldsymbol{x}_0 + \sigma_t \boldsymbol{\eta}, \quad \eta \sim \mathcal N(\mathbf{0}, I)xt​=x0​+σt​η,η∼N(0,I). 对大多数前向算子来说，似然无法写成闭式。因此已有若干近似方法被提出，用扩散模型求解逆问题 (Chung 等, 2023)、(Kawar 等)、(Jalal 等, 2021)、(Song 等, 2021)、(Chung 等, 2022)、(Feng 等, 2023)、(Graikos 等, 2022)。其中最简单、最有效的近似之一是 Diffusion Posterior Sampling（DPS）(Chung 等, 2023)。DPS 用 xt\boldsymbol{x}_txt​ 估计 x0\boldsymbol{x}_0x0​，并用条件似然 p(yinf∣x^0)p(\boldsymbol{y}_{\mathrm{inf}}\mid\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_0)p(yinf​∣x^0​) 代替不可计算的那一项，也就是说，DPS 用 p(yinf∣x0=E[x0∣xt])p(\boldsymbol{y}_{\mathrm{inf}} \mid \boldsymbol{x}_0=\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 \mid \boldsymbol{x}_t])p(yinf​∣x0​=E[x0​∣xt​]) 近似 p(yinf∣xt)p(\boldsymbol{y}_{\mathrm{inf}} \mid \boldsymbol{x}_t)p(yinf​∣xt​)，其中 γt\gamma_tγt​ 是可调引导参数。更新式变为：

For most forward operators it is intractable to write the likelihood in closed form. Hence, several approximations have been proposed to use diffusion models for inverse problems (Chung et al., 2023; Kawar et al.; Jalal et al., 2021; Song et al., 2021; Chung et al., 2022; Feng et al., 2023; Graikos et al., 2022). One of the simplest and most effective approximations is Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS) (Chung et al., 2023). DPS estimates x0\boldsymbol{x}_0x0​ using xt\boldsymbol{x}_txt​ and uses the conditional likelihood p(yinf∣x^0)p(\boldsymbol{y}_{\mathrm{inf}}|\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_0)p(yinf​∣x^0​) instead of the intractable term, i.e. DPS approximates p(yinf∣xt)p(\boldsymbol{y}_{\mathrm{inf}} | \boldsymbol{x}_t)p(yinf​∣xt​) with p(yinf∣x0=E[x0∣xt])p(\boldsymbol{y}_{\mathrm{inf}} | \boldsymbol{x}_0=\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 | \boldsymbol{x}_t])p(yinf​∣x0​=E[x0​∣xt​]), where γt\gamma_tγt​ is a tunable guidance parameter. The update rule becomes:

Ambient Diffusion

English original
Ambient Diffusion.

that provably learns E[x0∣A~train,y~t,train]\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 | \tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}, \tilde{\boldsymbol{y}}_{t, \mathrm{train}}]E[x0​∣A~train​,y~​t,train​] as long as the matrix E[AtrainTAtrain∣A~train]\mathbb{E}[A_{\mathrm{train}}^TA_{\mathrm{train}} | \tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}]E[AtrainT​Atrain​∣A~train​] is full-rank. 多线圈磁共振成像

English original
Multi-coil Magnetic Resonance Imaging.

MRI 是「从线性受损数据学习生成模型」这一框架的原型用例，因为在许多情况下收集大规模完整采样数据训练集并不可行 (Tibrewala 等, 2023)、(Desai 等, 2022)、(Tariq 等)。在 3D+时间 动态对比增强 MRI (Zhang 等, 2015) 等场景中，由于造影剂动力学随时间变化，根本无法采集完整采样数据 (Zhang 等)。

English original
MRI is a prototypical use case for a framework that can learn generative models from linearly corrupted data, as in many cases it is not feasible to collect a large training set of fully sampled data (Tibrewala et al., 2023; Desai et al., 2022; Tariq et al.). In settings such as 3D+time dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (Zhang et al., 2015) it is impossible to collect fully sampled data due to the time-varying dynamics of the contrast agent (Zhang et al.).

在多线圈 MRI 设定中，采集过程是由一组空间局部化的线圈，直接在空间频率（即 kkk 空间）中收集图像的测量。数学上共有 NcN_{\mathrm{c}}Nc​ 个线圈，每个线圈给出测量：

English original
In the multi-coil MRI setting, the acquisition involves collecting measurements of an image directly in the spatial frequency, known as kkk-space, from a set of spatially localized coils. Mathematically, there are NcN_{\mathrm{c}}Nc​ coils, each of which gives measurements:
公式 (2.5)
zx,i=PFSix+wi,i∈[Nc],\boldsymbol{z}_{\boldsymbol{x},i} = P \mathcal F S_i\boldsymbol{x} + \boldsymbol{w}_i, \quad i \in [N_{\mathrm{c}}],zx,i​=PFSi​x+wi​,i∈[Nc​],

其中 x\boldsymbol{x}x 是（复值的）目标图像，SiS_iSi​ 表示第 iii 个线圈的敏感度分布，F\mathcal FF 是傅里叶变换，PPP 表示傅里叶欠采样算子，wi\boldsymbol{w}_iwi​ 是复值高斯独立同分布噪声。我们假设无噪声情形；对于处理含噪情形的方法，请读者参见 (Daras 等, 2023a)、(Aali 等, 2023)、(Kawar 等, 2023)。

English original
where x\boldsymbol{x}x is the (complex-valued) image of interest, SiS_iSi​ represents the coil-sensitivity profile of the ithi^{th}ith coil, F\mathcal FF is the Fourier transform, PPP represents the Fourier subsampling operator and wi\boldsymbol{w}_iwi​ is complex-valued Gaussian i.i.d noise. We assume the noiseless case and we point the reader to Daras et al. (2023a), Aali et al. (2023), Kawar et al. (2023) for approaches that handle the noisy case.

把连续信号离散近似为图像 x∈Cn\boldsymbol{x} \in C^{n}x∈Cn 时，P,F,SiP, \mathcal F, S_iP,F,Si​ 的复合可以写成一个矩阵 Ai∈Cm×nA_i \in C^{m \times n}Ai​∈Cm×n，其中测量个数 mmm 取决于欠采样算子 PPP。通常用 RRR 表示比值 nm\frac{n}{m}mn​，称为加速因子。在推理时（也就是面对新患者时），我们通常希望用高加速因子采集数据，因为这样可以缩短扫描时间、减少患者不适。

English original
For the discrete approximation of the continuous signal as an image x\boldsymbol{x}x ∈\in∈ CnC^{n}Cn, the composition of P,F,SiP, \mathcal F, S_iP,F,Si​ can be written as a matrix Ai∈Cm×nA_i \in C^{m \times n}Ai​∈Cm×n, where the number of measurements, mmm, depends on the subsampling operator PPP. It is common to denote with RRR the ratio nm\frac{n}{m}mn​, which is known as the acceleration factor. At inference time (i.e., for a new patient), we typically want to acquire data with a high acceleration factor because this reduces scan time and patient discomfort.

由于采集 kkk 空间测量需要时间，通常无法获得完整采样的 kkk 空间。因此训练不能像全监督设定那样，依赖完整采样的图像来指导重建质量 (Aggarwal 等, 2019)、(Hammernik 等, 2018)。如果同一底层信号有两个独立测量，复原模型可以在没有干净数据的情况下训练 (Lehtinen 等, 2018)、(Gan 等, 2023)。如果只有一个测量（如本文设定），一些端到端技术会在测量域上定义损失：把每个样本的训练测量划分为 (1) 用于重建的测量，(2) 用于施加损失函数的测量 (Yaman 等, 2020)。其他方法利用 MRI 采集中的结构，从有限分辨率数据中学习 (Wang 等, 2023)。更近期，一些工作开始利用信号集合的性质（例如群不变性），来帮助从欠采样测量中学习各种逆问题 (Tachella 等, 2022b)、(Scanvic 等, 2023)、(Chen 等, 2022a)、(Tachella 等, 2022a)。本文所用的「额外破坏」这一想法，更接近 Noisier2Noise 框架 (Moran 等, 2020)，后者最初是为去噪提出的。Millard & Chiew (2023) 把这一想法推广到 MRI，在没有干净数据的情况下学习 MRI 复原模型。所有这些方法都在没有参考数据的情况下学习复原模型。但由于它们本质上是端到端方法，其在分布外任务（例如不同采集轨迹造成）上的性能已知会下降 (Jalal 等, 2021)、(Zach 等, 2022)。

English original
Due to the time required to collect kkk-space measurements, it is often not possible to acquire fully sampled kkk-space. Hence, training cannot rely on a fully sampled image to guide reconstruction quality as is done in the fully supervised setting (Aggarwal et al., 2019; Hammernik et al., 2018). If two independent measurements are available for the same underlying signal, restoration models can be trained without having access to uncorrupted data (Lehtinen et al., 2018; Gan et al., 2023). If only one measurement is available (as in our setting), some end-to-end techniques use a loss on the measurement domain by partitioning the training measurements for each sample into (1) measurements for reconstruction, and (2) measurements for applying the loss function (Yaman et al., 2020). Other approaches leverage structure in the MRI acquisition to learn from limited-resolution data (Wang et al., 2023). More recently, works have begun leveraging signal set properties such as group invariance to assist in learning from subsampled measurements for a variety of inverse problems (Tachella et al., 2022b; Scanvic et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2022a; Tachella et al., 2022a). The idea of additional corruption (as we do in our work), is more related to the Noisier2Noise framework (Moran et al., 2020) which has been initially developed for denoising. Millard & Chiew (2023) extended this idea to the MRI setting to learn models for MRI restoration without access to clean data. All these approaches learn a restoration model without access to reference data. However, as they are inherently end-to-end methods, their performance on out-of-distribution tasks (e.g., due to different acquisition trajectories) is known to degrade (Jalal et al., 2021; Zach et al., 2022).

2.2 MRI 的 Ambient Diffusion

English original
2.2 Ambient Diffusion for MRI

MRI 采集过程得到的是线性受损测量，因此理论上应该可以用 Ambient Diffusion 框架从受损观测中学习。然而，我们识别出三处与 Daras 等 (2023b) 所研究设定不同的重要变化：i) 修补发生在傅里叶域；ii) 修补是有结构的，即空间傅里叶中的整条竖线要么被观测、要么不被观测（而不是遮蔽随机像素）；iii) 图像是由一组空间变化的接收线圈测量的。下面我们说明如何处理这些因素，把 Ambient Diffusion 框架应用到 MRI 数据上。

English original
The MRI acquisition process results in linearly corrupted measurements and thus it should be possible to use the Ambient Diffusion framework to learn from corrupted observations. Yet, we identified three important changes that differ from the setting studied by Daras et al. (2023b): i) the inpainting happens in the Fourier Domain, ii) the inpainting has structure, i.e. whole vertical lines in the spatial Fourier are either observed or not observed (instead of masking random pixels) and, iii) the image is measured from an array of spatially varying receive coils. In what follows, we show how to account for these factors and apply the Ambient Diffusion framework to MRI data.

首先，与 Ambient Diffusion 一样，我们会进一步破坏给定测量，但在我们的情形中，额外破坏发生在傅里叶空间。我们通过降低傅里叶欠采样比例，为每个线圈构造进一步受损的测量，即构造迭代量：

English original
First, as in Ambient Diffusion, we will corrupt further the given measurements, but in our case, the additional corruption will happen in the Fourier space. We create further corrupted measurements for each coil by decreasing the Fourier subsampling ratio, i.e. we create iterates:

This is possible to do because we can just subsample the available data zx,i\boldsymbol{z}_{\boldsymbol{x},i}zx,i​. Due to the multiplicity of coils, we combine their measurements to form a crude estimator of x\boldsymbol{x}x by taking the adjoint of A~train\tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}A~train​: y~train=∑iSiHF−1(z~x,i)\tilde{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\mathrm{train}} = \sum_{i} S_i^H \mathcal F^{-1}(\tilde{\boldsymbol{z}}_{\boldsymbol{x}, i})y~​train​=∑i​SiH​F−1(z~x,i​). 与 Ambient Diffusion 一样，我们会训练网络去预测额外破坏之前的对应信号，也就是说，我们的目标是：

ytrain=(∑iSiHF−1PFSi)⏟Atrainx.\boldsymbol{y}_{\mathrm{train}} = \underbrace{\left(\sum_{i} S_i^H \mathcal F^{-1} P \mathcal F S_i\right)}_{A_{\mathrm{train}}}\boldsymbol{x}.ytrain​=Atrain​(i∑​SiH​F−1PFSi​)​​x.

is: hθ(y~t,train,P~)=E[x0∣y~t,train,P~]\boldsymbol{h}_{\theta}(\tilde{\boldsymbol{y}}_{t, \mathrm{train}}, \tilde P) = \mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 | \tilde{\boldsymbol{y}}_{t, \mathrm{train}}, \tilde P]hθ​(y~​t,train​,P~)=E[x0​∣y~​t,train​,P~].

The formal proof of this Theorem is given in the Appendix. We provide a sketch of the proof here. The techniques are based on Theorem 4.2 of Ambient Diffusion (Daras et al., 2023b). In Theorem 4.2, the condition that needs to be satisfied is that E[AtrainTAtrain∣A~train]\mathbb{E}[A_{\mathrm{train}}^T A_{\mathrm{train}}| \tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}]E[AtrainT​Atrain​∣A~train​] is full-rank. 2.4 用于域内重建的 Ambient Diffusion

English original
2.4 Ambient Diffusion for in-domain reconstructions.

Ambient DPS 可以求解任何前向算子已知的逆问题，只要使用在某种线性受损数据上训练的扩散模型。但需要强调的是：如果推理时要解的逆问题，其前向算子与训练测量所用的前向算子相同，那么我们可以把 Ambient Diffusion 当作监督式复原模型。这是因为 Ambient Diffusion 模型被训练来估计 E[x0∣y~train,A~train]\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 \mid \tilde{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\mathrm{train}}, \tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}]E[x0​∣y~​train​,A~train​]，因此如果 AinfA_{\mathrm{inf}}Ainf​ 与 AtrainA_{\mathrm{train}}Atrain​ 同分布，那么模型的一步预测（Ambient One Step，A-OS）就是均方误差（MSE）意义下的最小化者。类似地，如果我们关心的是无条件生成，只需运行不带似然项的 Ambient DPS。

English original
Ambient DPS can be used to solve any inverse problem for which the forward operator is known, using a diffusion model trained on linearly corrupted data of some form. It is important to underline though that if the inverse problem that we want to solve at inference time has the same forward operator as the one that was used for the training measurements, then we can use the Ambient Diffusion as a supervised restoration model. This is because Ambient Diffusion models are trained to estimate E[x0∣y~train,A~train]\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 | \tilde{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\mathrm{train}}, \tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}]E[x0​∣y~​train​,A~train​], and hence if AinfA_{\mathrm{inf}}Ainf​ comes from the same distribution as AtrainA_{\mathrm{train}}Atrain​, then, the one-step prediction of the model, Ambient One Step (A-OS), is the Mean Squared Error (MSE) minimizer. Similarly, if we are interested in unconditional generation, we can simply run Ambient DPS without the likelihood term.

3 实验

English original
3 Experiments

3.1 MRI 的 Ambient 扩散模型

English original
3.1 Ambient MRI Diffusion Models

本节我们把 Ambient Diffusion 扩展到多线圈傅里叶欠采样 MRI 设定（详见第 2.2 节），并从头训练自己的 MRI 模型。数据集准备的细节见附录 B。

English original
In this section, we extend Ambient Diffusion to the multi-coil Fourier subsampled MRI setting (as detailed in Section 2.2) and we train our own MRI models from scratch. We give details about our dataset preparation in Section B in the Appendix.

采样掩膜

English original
Sampling masks.

我们通过施加与加速因子 R∈{2,4,6,8}R \in \{2,4,6,8\}R∈{2,4,6,8} 对应的随机欠采样掩膜，对 kkk 空间训练数据做回顾性欠采样。采样掩膜包含与已观测傅里叶系数（相位编码）对应的完整采样竖线（读出方向）。我们始终采样中心 202020 条线用于自校准。为构造进一步受损的测量，我们随机再删除一些线，从而得到加速因子为 R+1R+1R+1 的测量。例如，取 R=2R=2R=2 的数据，构造 R=3R=3R=3 的进一步受损测量，然后训练模型：给定它对 R=3R=3R=3 受损输入的预测，用 R=2R=2R=2 的可用数据度量其误差，以此学习预测干净图像。

English original
We retrospectively subsample the kkk-space training data by applying randomly subsampled masks that correspond to acceleration factors R∈{2,4,6,8}R \in \{2, 4, 6, 8\}R∈{2,4,6,8}. The sampling masks include fully sampled vertical (readout) lines corresponding to the observed Fourier coefficients (phase encodes). We always sample the central 202020 lines for autocalibration. To form further corrupted measurements, we randomly remove additional lines such that we create measurements at acceleration factor R+1R+1R+1. For example, we take data at R=2R=2R=2, we create further corrupted measurements at R=3R=3R=3 and we train the model to predict the clean image by measuring its error with the available data at R=2R=2R=2 given its prediction for the R=3R=3R=3 corrupted input.

对照模型。我们为每个加速因子 R∈{1,2,4,6,8}R \in \{1,2,4,6,8\}R∈{1,2,4,6,8} 训练一个模型。R=1R=1R=1 的模型在干净数据（无额外破坏）上按照 EDM 方法 (Karras 等, 2022) 训练。R>1R>1R>1 的模型用我们修改后的 Ambient Diffusion 框架训练。虽然完整采样训练以 EDM 为主，我们也按 Jalal 等 (2021) 的方法为 R=1R=1R=1 训练了一个 NCSNV2 模型。作为基线，我们还在每个加速因子上，先对训练集做 L1-小波压缩感知重建，再训练 EDM 模型（L1-EDM）(Lustig 等, 2007)。

English original
Comparison Models. We train one model for each acceleration factor R∈{1,2,4,6,8}R \in \{1, 2, 4, 6, 8\}R∈{1,2,4,6,8}. The R=1R=1R=1 model is trained on clean data (no extra corruption) based on the EDM approach (Karras et al., 2022). The R>1R>1R>1 models are trained with our modified Ambient Diffusion framework. While we focus on EDM for fully sampled training, we also train an NCSNV2 model for R=1R=1R=1 following the approach in Jalal et al. (2021). As baselines, we also train EDM models after L1-Wavelet compressed sensing reconstruction (L1-EDM) of the training set at each acceleration factor (Lustig et al., 2007).

无条件生成评估

English original
Unconditional generation evaluation.

我们评估每个模型的无条件生成性能，并在图 2 中展示 Ambient Diffusion 模型与 R=1R=1R=1 的 EDM 模型的先验样本。与 Daras 等 (2023b) 的结果类似，我们观察到：在低加速时，Ambient Diffusion 的样本在质量上与 EDM 模型相近；在更高加速时则略变模糊。值得注意的是，Ambient Diffusion 在 R=8R=8R=8 生成的样本没有残余混叠伪影，这与 L1-小波重建生成的样本形成对照。

English original
We evaluate the unconditional generation performance of each model and show prior samples for Ambient Diffusion and EDM models at R=1R=1R=1 in Figure 2. Similar to the results in Daras et al. (2023b), we observe that the Ambient Diffusion samples are qualitatively similar to EDM models at low acceleration, and become slightly blurry at higher accelerations. Notably, the samples generated by Ambient Diffusion at R=8R=8R=8 have no residual aliasing artifacts, in contrast to the samples generated from L1-Wavelet reconstructions.

为量化无条件样本质量，我们沿用 (Bendel 等, 2022) 的做法，用预训练 VGG 网络从 100 个样本计算 FID 分数。表 1 给出各扩散模型的 FID 分数。虽然 Ambient 模型的 FID 有所上升，但可以看到在高加速因子上训练的 Ambient 模型优于在 L1-小波重建上训练的 L1-EDM 模型。

English original
To quantify unconditional sample quality, we follow the approach in (Bendel et al., 2022) and calculate FID scores from 100 samples using a pre-trained VGG network. Table 1, shows FID scores for the diffusion models. While there is an increase in FID for the Ambient models, we see that those trained at higher acceleration factors outperform L1-EDM models trained on L1-Wavelet reconstructions.

3.2 加速 MRI 重建

English original
3.2 Accelerated MRI Reconstruction

接下来我们评估在欠采样 MRI 数据上训练的 Ambient Diffusion 模型的加速重建性能。我们的方法 A-DPS 按公式 (2.11) 实现，迭代 500500500 步，似然权重取 γt=1∥y−AE[x0∣yt,train,Atrain]∥2\gamma_t = \frac{1}{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}-A\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 \mid \boldsymbol{y}_{t, \mathrm{train}}, A_{\mathrm{train}}]\right\|_2}γt​=∥y−AE[x0​∣yt,train​,Atrain​]∥2​1​。我们考虑以下基线：

English original
We now evaluate the accelerated reconstruction performance of Ambient Diffusion models trained on subsampled MRI data. Our method, A-DPS was implemented by following Eq. 2.11 for 500500500 steps with likelihood weighting γt=1∥y−AE[x0∣yt,train,Atrain]∥2\gamma_t = \frac{1}{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}-A\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 | \boldsymbol{y}_{t, \mathrm{train}}, A_{\mathrm{train}}]\right\|_2}γt​=∥y−AE[x0​∣yt,train​,Atrain​]∥2​1​. We consider the following baselines:

完整采样扩散后验采样（FS-DPS）。对于在干净数据上训练的模型，可以使用 Diffusion Posterior Sampling（DPS）(Chung 等, 2023) 算法。具体来说，我们用完整采样真值图像训练的扩散模型实现 DPS（FS-DPS），推理使用公式 (2.3) 的更新式，共 500500500 步，取 γt=1∥y−AE[x0∣xt]∥2\gamma_t = \frac{1}{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}-A\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 \mid \boldsymbol{x}_t]\right\|_2}γt​=∥y−AE[x0​∣xt​]∥2​1​。

English original
Fully-Sampled Diffusion Posterior Sampling (FS-DPS). For models trained on clean data, we can use the Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS) (Chung et al., 2023) algorithm. Specifically, we implemented the DPS algorithm with a Diffusion model trained with fully sampled ground truth images (FS-DPS). Inference was run using the update rule of Eq. 2.3, for a total of 500500500 steps and with γt=1∥y−AE[x0∣xt]∥2\gamma_t = \frac{1}{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}-A\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 | \boldsymbol{x}_t]\right\|_2}γt​=∥y−AE[x0​∣xt​]∥2​1​.

完整采样退火朗之万动力学（FS-ALD）。用基于分数的先验求解逆问题的一个流行方法是 ALD (Jalal 等, 2021)。我们用与上面相同的 10,00010,00010,000 个完整采样样本训练一个基于分数的模型，推理 1,3001,3001,300 步。该方法是我们方法的另一个完整采样对照。

English original
Fully-Sampled Annealed Langevin Dynamics (FS-ALD). A popular method for solving inverse problems via score-based priors is ALD (Jalal et al., 2021). We train a score-based model using the same fully sampled 10,00010,00010,000 samples as above and run inference for 1,3001,3001,300 steps. This method acts as another fully sampled comparison to our technique.

L1-小波压缩感知（L1-CS）。我们使用前面描述的同一个 L1-小波重建，作为独立的非深度学习对照。

English original
L1-Wavelet Compressed Sensing (L1-CS). We use the same L1-Wavelet reconstruction described previously as a standalone non-deep learning comparison.

模型驱动深度学习监督式（MoDL-Sup）。我们对每个加速因子，以监督方式使用 MoDL 架构 (Aggarwal 等, 2019) 训练端到端模型。推理时把欠采样数据送入训练好的 MoDL 网络。该基线的更多细节见附录 C。

English original
Model Based Deep Learning Supervised (MoDL-Sup). We use a supervised end-to-end model using the MoDL architecture in a supervised fashion (Aggarwal et al., 2019) for each acceleration factor. For inference, we pass the undersampled data through the trained MoDL network. Further details of this baseline are mentioned in Section C in the appendix.

Ambient 退火朗之万动力学（A-ALD）。我们把 Ambient Diffusion MRI 模型与逆问题求解器 ALD (Jalal 等, 2021) 结合，运行 1,3001,3001,300 步。

English original
Ambient Annealed Langevin Dynamics (A-ALD). We utilize our Ambient Diffusion MRI models with the inverse problem solver ALD (Jalal et al., 2021) for 1,3001,3001,300 steps.

Ambient 一步法（A-OS）。我们的方法也允许一步解。第 2.4 节已指出，我们训练模型去估计 E[x0∣y~train,A~train]\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 \mid \tilde{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\mathrm{train}}, \tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}]E[x0​∣y~​train​,A~train​]，因此可以一步使用模型。一步预测的性能只应期望在分布内（即评估加速因子与训练时相同）时表现良好。

English original
Ambient One Step (A-OS). Our method also admits a one-step solution. This is outlined in section 2.4 by noting that we train our model to estimate E[x0∣y~train,A~train]\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 | \tilde{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\mathrm{train}}, \tilde A_{\mathrm{train}}]E[x0​∣y~​train​,A~train​]. Thus we can use our models in a one-step fashion. The performance of the one-step prediction should only be expected to be good in-distribution, i.e. when the model is evaluated at the same acceleration factor as the one during training.

L1-扩散后验采样（L1-DPS）。我们使用在 R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8 测量集的 L1-小波重建上训练的扩散模型。重建时使用 DPS，共 500500500 步，γt=1∥y−AE[x0∣xt]∥2\gamma_t = \frac{1}{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}-A\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 \mid \boldsymbol{x}_t]\right\|_2}γt​=∥y−AE[x0​∣xt​]∥2​1​。

English original
L1-Diffusion Posterior Sampling (L1-DPS). We utilize the diffusion models trained on the L1-Wavelet reconstructions of data from measurement sets at R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8. For reconstruction, we use DPS for a total of 500500500 steps with γt=1∥y−AE[x0∣xt]∥2\gamma_t = \frac{1}{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}-A\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}_0 | \boldsymbol{x}_t]\right\|_2}γt​=∥y−AE[x0​∣xt​]∥2​1​.

基于数据欠采样的自监督学习（SSDU）。我们用端到端复原网络训练 SSDU (Yaman 等, 2020) 模型：把每个样本 yiΩy^\Omega_iyiΩ​ 的可用测量（Ω\OmegaΩ）划分为训练集（Θ\ThetaΘ）与损失集（Λ\LambdaΛ），即测量 yiΘy^\Theta_iyiΘ​ 与 yiΛy^\Lambda_iyiΛ​。SSDU 的进一步训练细节见附录 C。

English original
Self-Supervised learning via Data Under-sampling (SSDU). We train SSDU (Yaman et al., 2020) models using the end-to-end restoration network by splitting the available measurements (Ω\OmegaΩ) of each sample yiΩy^\Omega_iyiΩ​ into training sets (Θ\ThetaΘ) and loss sets (Λ\LambdaΛ) or measurements yiΘy^\Theta_iyiΘ​ and yiΛy^\Lambda_iyiΛ​. Further SSDU training details are given in Section C.

1D 划分 SSDU。我们训练 1D-Partitioned SSDU (Millard & Chiew, 2023)，它源自 SSDU 框架，并引入采样集划分，以保证每个子集的分布与原掩膜相似。损失函数、网络架构与训练超参数均按 (Millard & Chiew, 2023) 设置。

English original
1D-Partitioned SSDU. We train 1D-Partitioned SSDU (Millard & Chiew, 2023) which stems from the SSDU framework and introduces partitioning of the sampling set to ensure each subset has a distribution similar to the original mask. The loss function, network architecture, and training hyperparameters were set according to (Millard & Chiew, 2023).

所列方法的定量指标见表 2，分别给出 NRMSE、SSIM 和 PSNR。此外，我们在附录表 3 中报告了基于特征的指标 LPIPS 与 DISTS。在低加速水平（R=2,4R=2,4R=2,4）下，FS-DPS 优于大多数方法，包括 A-DPS。然而，随着验证加速比 RRR 升高，A-DPS 超过了其他模型，包括那些在完整采样数据上训练的模型。

我们还在一组欠采样腹部 MRI 扫描上训练了 Ambient Diffusion 模型，该数据没有真值可用 (Zhang 等, 2015)。附录（图 7、图 8）给出了先验采样与后验采样实验的可视化示例。

We also trained an Ambient Diffusion model on undersampled abdominal MRI scans, where no ground truth data is available (Zhang et al., 2015). We show visual examples from the prior and posterior sampling experiments in the Appendix (Figs 7, 8).

我们在图 3 中可视化了所列方法中一部分在不同加速因子下的重建结果。这里可以看到，在较低加速（R=4R=4R=4）时 FS-DPS 优于 A-DPS；但在更高加速（R=8R=8R=8）时，FS-DPS 会在重建中引入明显伪影，而我们的 A-DPS 重建保持了较高的视觉保真度。我们还在表 1 中报告了 A-DPS 与 FS-DPS 后验样本与真值分布之间的分布度量（条件 FID）。与后验重建指标的发现类似，在更高加速（R=8R=8R=8）区间，A-DPS 优于 FS-DPS。附录（图 9–13）还给出了 A-DPS、A-OS、FS-DPS、L1-DPS、FS-ALD、L1-CS、MoDL-Sup 与 SSDU 的 NRMSE、SSIM、PSNR 图形趋势。

3.3 在自然图像数据集上使用预训练模型的 Ambient Diffusion

English original
3.3 Ambient Diffusion with Pre-trained Models on Datasets of Natural Images

我们使用 Ambient Diffusion (Daras 等, 2023b) 中在不同擦除概率的随机修补数据上训练的模型。具体来说，对 AFHQ 使用擦除概率 p∈{0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8}p \in \{0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8\}p∈{0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8} 的 Ambient 模型，对 Celeb-A 使用 p∈{0.6,0.8,0.9}p \in \{0.6, 0.8, 0.9\}p∈{0.6,0.8,0.9} 的预训练模型。需要强调，所有 Ambient 模型在无条件生成上的表现都差于用干净数据训练的模型（即 p=0.0p=0.0p=0.0 的模型）。本文关注的是 Ambient 模型的条件生成性能，其条件信息在测量 yinf\boldsymbol{y}_{\mathrm{inf}}yinf​ 中，并与在未受损数据上训练的模型比较。为保证 Ambient 模型没有不公平优势，我们只在与其训练所遇任务不同的复原任务上测试。具体来说，我们用随机修补训练的模型，评估高斯压缩感知 (Baraniuk, 2007) 与超分辨率。

English original
We use the models from the Ambient Diffusion (Daras et al., 2023b) that are trained on randomly inpainted data with different erasure probabilities. Specifically, for AFHQ we use the Ambient Models with erasure probability p∈{0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8}p \in \{0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8\}p∈{0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8} and for Celeb-A we use the pre-trained models with p∈{0.6,0.8,0.9}p \in \{0.6, 0.8, 0.9\}p∈{0.6,0.8,0.9}. We underline that all the Ambient Models have worse performance for unconditional generation than those trained with clean data (i.e. the models trained with p=0.0p=0.0p=0.0). This work aims to explore the conditional generation performance of Ambient Models, where the conditioning is in the measurements yinf\boldsymbol{y}_{\mathrm{inf}}yinf​, and compare it with models trained on uncorrupted data. To ensure that Ambient Models do not have an unfair advantage, we test only on restoration tasks that differ from those encountered in their training. Specifically, we use models trained on random inpainting and we evaluate Gaussian Compressed Sensing (Baraniuk, 2007) and Super Resolution.

结果

English original
Results.

在图 4 中，我们展示了自然图像含噪超分辨率实验的可视化示例，对比：(1) 用完整采样数据训练的模型（FS-DPS），(2) 用 p=0.6p=0.6p=0.6 随机修补数据训练的模型（A-DPS）。图 5 给出高斯压缩感知重建结果（即从高斯随机投影重建信号）。我们展示 AFHQ 数据集在不同测量数下的 MSE 与 LPIPS 指标。结果来自在不同破坏程度上用修补图像训练的模型，破坏程度由擦除概率 ppp 表示。当测量数很高时，用干净数据训练的模型优于用受损数据训练的模型；但随着测量数减少，在测量极少的区间，Ambient 模型反而超过用干净数据训练的模型。据我们所知，目前没有已知的理论论证能解释这种性能交叉，进一步理解它是一个有趣的研究方向。图 6 给出 AFHQ 上超分辨率任务的类似结果：在重建 2×2\times2× 降采样图像时，干净数据模型（p=0p=0p=0）在 LPIPS 与 MSE 上如预期地略优于 Ambient 模型；但随着分辨率降低，性能再次出现交叉，用受损数据训练的模型开始超过用未受损数据训练的模型。FFHQ 与 Celeb-A 的压缩感知和降采样 LPIPS/MSE 结果见附录（图 15–18）。

English original
In Figure 4 we show visual examples from our experiment on the noisy super-resolution task for natural images using a model: (1) trained with fully-sampled data (FS-DPS), (2) trained with randomly inpainted data at p=0.6p=0.6p=0.6 (A-DPS). Figure 5 presents Gaussian Compressed Sensing reconstruction results (i.e. reconstructing a signal from Gaussian random projections). We show MSE and LPIPS performance metrics for the AFHQ dataset across varying number of measurements. The results are given for models that are trained with inpainted images at different levels of corruption, indicated by the erasure probability ppp. The model trained with clean data outperforms the models trained with corrupted data when the number of measurements is high. However, as we reduce the number of measurements, Ambient Models outperform the models trained with clean data in the very low measurements regime. To the best of our knowledge, there is no known theoretical argument that explains this performance cross-over, and understanding this further is an interesting research direction. Similar results are presented in Figure 6 for the task of super-resolution at AFHQ. The model trained on clean data (p=0p=0p=0) slightly outperforms the Ambient Models in both LPIPS and MSE for reconstructing a 2×2\times2× downsampled image, as expected. Yet, as the resolution decreases, there is again a cross-over in performance and models trained on corrupted data start to outperform the models trained on uncorrupted data. We include results for LPIPS and MSE for Compressed Sensing and Downsampling in FFHQ and Celeb-A in the Appendix (Figs 15, 16, 17, 18).

我们在 FFHQ 的另外几种逆问题设定下计算 MSE：方块修补、加性高斯噪声，以及超分辨率（含高斯噪声 σ=0.05\sigma=0.05σ=0.05）。我们发现该实验的趋势与前面的发现一致。不同降采样因子与噪声水平下的结果见附录（图 19、20、21）。最后，我们考察采样步数对性能的影响。AFHQ 上 400040004000 个测量的压缩感知 MSE 结果见图 14。可以看到，训练时擦除概率 ppp 越高，模型在低函数评估次数（NFE）下的压缩感知性能越好。用更高破坏程度训练的模型更快，因为它们用更少的步数就能达到相近性能；当 NFE 增大时，用更干净数据训练的模型反而更优。这一结果在不同数据集（AFHQ、FFHQ、CelebA）、重建任务（压缩感知、降采样）与指标（MSE、LPIPS）上一致（附录图 22–26）。

English original
We compute MSE in other inverse problem settings for FFHQ: Box Inpainting, Additive Gaussian Noise, and Super Resolution (with Gaussian Noise σ=0.05\sigma=0.05σ=0.05). We find that trends in this experiment are consistent with previous findings. The results across multiple downsampling factors and noise levels in the Appendix (Figs 19, 20, 21). Finally, we examine how the number of sampling steps affects the performance. The MSE results for Compressed Sensing with 400040004000 measurements on AFHQ are shown in Figure 14. As shown, the higher the erasure probability ppp during training, the better the Compressed Sensing performance of the model for low Number of Function Evaluations (NFEs). Models trained with higher corruption are faster since they require fewer steps for similar performance. For increased NFEs, the models trained on clean(er) data outperform. This result is consistent across different datasets (AFHQ, FFHQ, CelebA), reconstruction tasks (Compressed Sensing, Downsampling), and metrics (MSE, LPIPS) (Figs 22, 23, 24, 25, 26 in the Appendix).

4 结论

English original
4 Conclusion

我们提出 Ambient Diffusion Posterior Sampling（A-DPS），一个基于 DPS、用 Ambient Diffusion 模型求解逆问题的简单框架。我们表明，在受损数据上训练的 Ambient Diffusion 模型，可能更适合处理严重破坏下的病态逆问题。由于接触过受损训练数据，A-DPS 表现出稳健的先验，能更好地泛化到高加速区间；而 FS-DPS 可能过拟合干净数据，无法有效适应严重欠采样。我们的框架充分释放了 Ambient Diffusion 模型的潜力，这在无法获取或不宜获取完整数据的应用中至关重要。

English original
We present Ambient Diffusion Posterior Sampling (A-DPS), a simple framework based on DPS for solving inverse problems with Ambient Diffusion models. We show that Ambient Diffusion models trained on corrupted data can be better suited for handling ill-posed inverse problems under severe corruption. By being exposed to corrupted training data, A-DPS exhibits robust priors that generalize better to high-acceleration regimes, unlike FS-DPS, which may overfit clean data and fail to adapt effectively to severe undersampling. Our framework fully unlocks the potential of Ambient Diffusion models that are critical in applications where access to full data is impossible or undesirable.

This is true for any given set SiS_iSi​ and hence it is also true for the expectation over the sets {Si}\{S_i\}{Si​}. Putting everything together, we have that:
公式 (A.18)
E{Si},P[∑iSiHF−1E[P∣P~]FSi∣P~]=E[A∣P~],\mathbb{E}_{\{S_i\}, P}\left[\sum_i S_i^H \mathcal F^{-1} \mathbb{E}[P \mid \tilde P] \mathcal F S_i \mathrel{\bigg|} \tilde P\right] = \mathbb{E}[A \mid \tilde P],E{Si​},P​[i∑​SiH​F−1E[P∣P~]FSi​​P~]=E[A∣P~],

满秩，证明完成。■\blacksquare■

English original
is full-rank and the proof is complete.

关于其它 Ambient Diffusion 设计的说明

English original
Note on alternative Ambient Diffusion designs.

我们的 Ambient Diffusion MRI 训练方法可以扩展为使用其它线性算子来聚合不同线圈的测量（例如改用伪逆）。或者，我们也可以进一步以敏感度图为条件，或直接把所有线圈测量送入网络而不做聚合。我们选择了简单快速的方法（通过伴随聚合）。不过，这些其它方法可能带来更好的性能，因为它们充分利用了线圈信息。

English original
Our Ambient Diffusion MRI training approach can be extended to use other linear operators to aggregate the measurements from different coils (e.g. we could have used the pseudoinverse). Alternatively, we can also further condition on the sensitivity maps, or directly feed all the coil measurements as input to the network without aggregation. We opted for a simple and fast method (aggregation through the adjoint). However, these other approaches can lead to improved performance because they fully leverage coil information.

附录 B 数据准备

English original
Appendix B Dataset Preparation

我们遵循 MRI 文献的常规做法。我们下载 FastMRI 数据集，随机选择 2,000 个 T2 加权扫描，并从每个扫描中取 5 张中心切片，从而得到一个包含 10,000 张 T2 加权脑部扫描（kkk 空间测量）的数据集。我们把每个多通道 kkk 空间样本通过噪声预白化滤波器，将噪声变换为标准高斯白噪声。然后，我们用自校准区域（中心 24×2424\times2424×24 像素）的根和平方（root sum-of-squares）重建绝对值的第 999999 百分位数来归一化每个 kkk 空间样本。给定完整采样的 kkk 空间样本，我们用 ESPIRiT 校准方法 (Uecker 等, 2014) 估计敏感度图。这些测量构成完整采样的参考数据集（即 R=1R=1R=1）。

English original
We follow standard practices in the MRI literature. We download the FastMRI dataset, randomly select 2,000 T2-Weighted scans, and pick 5 center slices from each scan, giving us a dataset of 10,000 T2-weighted brain scans (kkk-space measurements). We pass each multi-channel kkk-space sample through a noise pre-whitening filter to transform the noise into standard white Gaussian. Then, we normalize each kkk-space sample by the absolute value of 999999-th percentile of the root sum-of-squares reconstruction of the autocalibration region (24x×2424x\times2424x×24 pixels from the center). Given the fully sampled kkk-space samples, we estimate sensitivity maps using the ESPIRiT calibration method (Uecker et al., 2014). These measurements serve as a fully sampled reference dataset (i.e., R=1R=1R=1).

附录 C 基线细节

English original
Appendix C Details for baselines.

L1 方法

English original
L1 Methods.

我们使用 BART 实现 (Uecker 等, 2016)、(Blumenthal 等, 2022)，并在训练集上搜索最佳正则化参数。具体来说，我们使用正则化权重 0.001、迭代 100 次。

English original
We used the BART implementation (Uecker et al., 2016; Blumenthal et al., 2022) and searched for the best regularization parameter over the training set. Specifically, we used a regularization weighting of 0.001 with 100 iterations.

基于数据欠采样的自监督学习（SSDU）

English original
Self-Supervised learning via Data Under-sampling (SSDU)

在监督设定中，端到端图像复原网络可以通过把测量送入 MoDL (Aggarwal 等, 2019) 或 VarNet (Hammernik 等, 2018) 之类的网络，并直接以真值图像在网络输出上取损失来训练。但在自监督设定中这不可行。SSDU 通过把每个样本 yiΩy^\Omega_iyiΩ​ 的可用测量集（Ω\OmegaΩ）划分为训练集（Θ\ThetaΘ）与损失集（Λ\LambdaΛ），即测量 yiΘy^\Theta_iyiΘ​ 与 yiΛy^\Lambda_iyiΛ​（Ω=Θ∪Λ\Omega = \Theta \cup \LambdaΩ=Θ∪Λ），来训练端到端复原网络。重建网络获得训练集测量以得到估计图像 x^iΘ=hθ(yiΘ)\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}^{\Theta}_i = \boldsymbol{h}_\theta(y^\Theta_i)x^iΘ​=hθ​(yiΘ​)，损失随后定义在损失集测量上：

English original
In a supervised setting, end-to-end image restoration networks can be trained by passing measurements through a network like MoDL (Aggarwal et al., 2019) or VarNet (Hammernik et al., 2018) and taking a loss directly on the output of the network with the ground truth image. In the self-supervised setting, however, this is not possible. SSDU, trains the end-to-end restoration network by splitting the available measurement set (Ω\OmegaΩ) of each sample yiΩy^\Omega_iyiΩ​ into training sets (Θ\ThetaΘ) and loss sets (Λ\LambdaΛ) or measurements yiΘy^\Theta_iyiΘ​ and yiΛy^\Lambda_iyiΛ​ respectively where Ω=Θ∪Λ\Omega = \Theta \cup \LambdaΩ=Θ∪Λ. Where the reconstruction network is given access to measurements in the training set to obtain an estimated image x^iΘ=hθ(yiΘ)\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}^{\Theta}_i = \boldsymbol{h}_\theta(y^\Theta_i)x^iΘ​=hθ​(yiΘ​) and the loss is then defined over the loss measurements as
公式 (C.1)
L(yiΛ,x^iΘ)=∥yiΛ−AΛx^iΘ∥1∥yiΛ∥1+∥yiΛ−AΛx^iΘ∥2∥yiΛ∥2L(\boldsymbol{y}^\Lambda_i,\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}^{\Theta}_i) = \frac{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}^\Lambda_i - A_\Lambda \hat{\boldsymbol{x}}^{\Theta}_i\right\|_1}{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}^\Lambda_i\right\|_1} + \frac{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}^\Lambda_i - A_\Lambda \hat{\boldsymbol{x}}^{\Theta}_i\right\|_2}{\left\|\boldsymbol{y}^\Lambda_i\right\|_2}L(yiΛ​,x^iΘ​)=​yiΛ​​1​​yiΛ​−AΛ​x^iΘ​​1​​+​yiΛ​​2​​yiΛ​−AΛ​x^iΘ​​2​​

其中 AΛA_\LambdaAΛ​ 是前向算子：其选择掩膜 PPP 只在损失集的测量位置取一、其它位置取零。本文中我们选择 hθ(⋅)\boldsymbol{h}_\theta(\cdot)hθ​(⋅) 为 MoDL 架构 (Aggarwal 等, 2019)。我们在四个不同加速水平（R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8）分别训练模型。每个模型用与前文相同的训练集（10,00010,00010,000 张切片）训练十个 epoch。我们用均匀随机采样为每个样本划分训练测量组与损失测量组，发现划分比例 ρ=∣Λ∣∣Ω∣=0.2\rho = \frac{|\Lambda|}{|\Omega|} = 0.2ρ=∣Ω∣∣Λ∣​=0.2 性能最好，因此后续所有指标的训练都采用这一设置。

English original
where AΛA_\LambdaAΛ​ is the forward operator with ones in the selection mask PPP at only the measurement locations in the loss set and zeros elsewhere. In this work, we selected hθ(⋅)\boldsymbol{h}_\theta(\cdot)hθ​(⋅) to have the MoDL architecture (Aggarwal et al., 2019). We trained individual models at four different acceleration levels (R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8). Each model was trained for ten epochs using the same training set (10,00010,00010,000 slices) as previously described. We used uniform random sampling to separate the training and loss measurement groups for each sample and found that a split of ρ=∣Λ∣∣Ω∣=0.2\rho = \frac{|\Lambda|}{|\Omega|} = 0.2ρ=∣Ω∣∣Λ∣​=0.2 provided the best performance and thus was used for reporting all subsequent metrics.

MoDL 监督式（MoDL-Sup）

English original
MoDL Supervised (MoDL-Sup)

为给出监督式端到端方法性能的上界，我们还以监督方式训练了 MoDL 架构 (Aggarwal 等, 2019)。同样，我们在四个不同加速水平（R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8）分别训练模型，每个模型使用与上面相同的 10,00010,00010,000 张切片。不过，这些模型使用归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）作为损失函数：

English original
To provide an upper bound on performance for supervised end-to-end methods we also trained the MoDL architecture in a supervised fashion (Aggarwal et al., 2019). Again, we trained individual models at four different acceleration levels (R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8R=2,4,6,8). Each model was trained using the same 10,00010,00010,000 slices as above. However, for these models, we used the normalized root mean squared error (NRMSE) as the loss function:
公式 (C.2)
L(xi,x^i)=∥xi−x^i∥2∥xi∥2L(\boldsymbol{x}_i,\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_i) = \frac{\left\|\boldsymbol{x}_i - \hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_i\right\|_2}{\left\|\boldsymbol{x}_i\right\|_2}L(xi​,x^i​)=∥xi​∥2​∥xi​−x^i​∥2​​

其中 xi\boldsymbol{x}_ixi​ 是数据集的真值图像，x^i=hθ(yi,Ai)\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_i = \boldsymbol{h}_\theta(\boldsymbol{y}_i, A_i)x^i​=hθ​(yi​,Ai​) 是网络基于欠采样测量 yi\boldsymbol{y}_iyi​ 给出的重建。

English original
where xi\boldsymbol{x}_ixi​ are the ground truth images from our dataset and x^i=hθ(yi,Ai)\hat{\boldsymbol{x}}_i = \boldsymbol{h}_\theta(\boldsymbol{y}_i, A_i)x^i​=hθ​(yi​,Ai​) are the reconstructions provided by our network based on under-sampled measurements yi\boldsymbol{y}_iyi​.

附录 D MRI 模型的超参数

English original
Appendix D Hyperparameters for MRI models

训练超参数

English original
Training Hyperparameters.

在完整采样（R=1R=1R=1）数据集上训练的 EDM 模型，以及在每个加速因子 R∈{2,4,6,8}R \in \{2,4,6,8\}R∈{2,4,6,8} 的 L1-小波重建上训练的四个 EDM 模型，均为 6500 万参数。相比之下，Ambient Diffusion 模型为 3600 万参数，以便更快训练。所有 Ambient Diffusion 模型训练 250 个 epoch。在 Ambient Diffusion 训练实验中，进一步受损的采样掩膜以与测量在通道维上拼接的方式作为模型输入，与原始 Ambient Diffusion (Daras 等, 2023b) 论文一致。

English original
The EDM model trained on the fully-sampled (R=1R=1R=1) dataset, as well as the four EDM models trained on L1-Wavelet reconstructions at each acceleration factor R∈{2,4,6,8}R \in \{2, 4, 6, 8\}R∈{2,4,6,8} were all trained with 65 million parameters. The Ambient Diffusion models on the other hand were trained with 36 million parameters, for faster training. All the Ambient Diffusion models were trained for 250 epochs. For the Ambient Diffusion training experiments, the further corrupted sampling masks are given as an input to the model by concatenating with the measurements along the channel dimension, as in the original Ambient Diffusion (Daras et al., 2023b) paper.

采样超参数

English original
Sampling Hyperparameters.

DPS（公式 (2.3)）与 Ambient DPS（公式 (2.11)）唯一可调的参数，是测量似然项幅度的调度。在 DPS 论文的所有实验中，这一项在整条扩散采样轨迹上保持常数，作者建议在 [0.1,10][0.1, 10][0.1,10] 范围内取值。我们遵循这一建议，保持该项为常数。每个模型的步长值通过在建议范围内做超参数搜索确定。在我们所有实验中，我们完全沿用论文官方代码仓库提供的 DPS 实现。另一个影响性能的参数是每个算法的运行步数，即公式 (2.3)、(2.11) 中 SDE 的离散化程度。

English original
The only tunable parameters for DPS (Eq. 2.3) and Ambient DPS (Eq. 2.11) are in the scheduling of the magnitude of the measurements likelihood term. In all the experiments in the DPS paper, this term is kept constant throughout the diffusion sampling trajectory and the authors recommend selecting a value in the range between [0.1,10][0.1, 10][0.1,10]. We follow this recommendation and we keep this term constant. The value of the step size for each model is selected with a hyperparameter search in the recommended range. For all our experiments, we follow exactly the DPS implementation provided in the official code repository of the paper. The other parameter that impacts performance is the number of steps we are going to run each algorithm for, i.e. the discretization level of the SDEs of Equations 2.3, 2.11.

通常步数越多性能越好，因为离散化误差会减小 (Chen 等, 2022b)、(Chen 等, 2023)。在性能结果中，我们对每个方法运行若干步数 ∈{50,100,150,200,250,300}\in \{50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300\}∈{50,100,150,200,250,300}。

English original
Typically, the higher the number of steps the better the performance since the discretization error decreases (Chen et al., 2022b; Chen et al., 2023). For the performance results, we run each method for several steps ∈{50,100,150,200,250,300}\in \{50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300\}∈{50,100,150,200,250,300}.

English original
Appendix E Additional MRI Results

附录 F 补充自然图像性能结果

English original
Appendix F Additional Natural Image Performance Results

以下实验中，我们比较一个无破坏训练的模型与一个用 p=0.6p=0.6p=0.6 随机修补数据训练的模型。评估数据集为 FFHQ。两个模型的训练规模与超参数相同。对两个模型，我们都大量调优采样超参数以最大化性能（从 DPS 工作推荐的超参数出发）。这些补充实验得到的发现是：在所有评估任务上，用受损（修补）数据训练的模型在高破坏区间都优于用干净数据训练的模型。

English original
For the following experiments, we compare a model trained without corruption to a model trained with randomly inpainted data at p=0.6p=0.6p=0.6. The evaluation dataset is FFHQ. The training size and hyperparameters for both models are the same. For both models, we extensively tune the sampling hyperparameters to maximize their performance (starting from the recommended hyperparameters from the DPS work). The finding we get in these additional experiments is that the model trained on corrupted data (inpainting) outperforms the model trained on clean data in the high corruption regime across all evaluation tasks.

附录 G 补充自然图像速度结果

English original
Appendix G Additional Natural Image Speed Results

附录 H 局限与未来方向

English original
Appendix H Limitations and Future Directions

我们的工作有若干局限。第一，对观察到的实验现象缺乏理论理解：我们还不清楚为什么在高度受损数据上训练的模型，会为另一类破坏的逆问题带来更好的先验。第二，我们只用 DPS 算法测试了模型的重建性能。近期还有若干其它用扩散模型求解逆问题的算法，我们的发现是否能推广到这些重建算法尚不清楚。最后，我们的方法依赖 Ambient Diffusion 模型的存在。目前在干净数据上训练的模型远多于在高度受损数据上训练的模型。

English original
Our work has several limitations. First, there is a lack of theoretical understanding of the observed experimental phenomenon: we do not have a good grasp of why models trained on highly corrupted data lead to better priors for inverse problems of another corruption type. Second, we only tested the reconstruction performance of our models using the DPS algorithm. Several other recent algorithms have been developed for solving inverse problems with diffusion models and it is unknown whether our findings generalize for these reconstruction algorithms. Finally, our method relies on the existence of Ambient Diffusion models. There are many more models available trained on clean data than models trained on highly corrupted data.

自校准信号（ACS）区域在所有训练样本间共享，这可能导致某些 kkk 空间区域被过度表示。我们目前的方法没有显式处理这一点，但按 (Millard & Chiew, 2023) 的建议，在损失函数中引入对角加权矩阵，是缓解该问题的一个有前景的方向。

English original
The auto-calibration signal (ACS) region is shared across training samples, which could lead to an over-representation of certain k-space regions. While our current approach does not explicitly address this, introducing a diagonal weighting matrix in the loss function, as suggested by (Millard & Chiew, 2023), is a promising direction to mitigate this issue.

目前我们按公式 (2.7) 定义 AtrainA_{\mathrm{train}}Atrain​。这很方便，因为它让我们能使用 EDM 所用的图像到图像网络架构。另一种做法是直接按公式 (2.5) 定义 AtrainA_{\mathrm{train}}Atrain​，此时网络会从多线圈 kkk 空间映射到图像。该网络可以前面接一个 IFFT，实际上就是一个多线圈到图像的映射，并且可以用线圈压缩 (Zhang 等, 2013) 来标准化。这样的网络架构可能有趣且更具表达能力，因为我们目前是通过零填充伴随把多线圈信息坍缩掉的。还有一种可能是把 AtrainA_{\mathrm{train}}Atrain​ 定义为作用于 AAA 的伪逆，这可以用共轭梯度算法高效求解。

English original
Currently, we define AtrainA_{train}Atrain​ according to Eq 2.7. This is convenient because it lets us use an image-to-image network architecture such as that used by EDM. An alternative could be to define AtrainA_{train}Atrain​ directly as in Eq 2.5, in which case the network would go from multi-coil k-space to an image. This network could be preceded by an IFFT, which would effectively be a multi-coil-to-image network, and could be standardized using coil compression (Zhang et al., 2013). Such a network architecture could be interesting and potentially more expressive, as we currently collapse the multi-coil information through zero-filling adjoint. Another possibility is to define AtrainA_{train}Atrain​ as the pseudo-inverse applied to AAA, which could be solved efficiently with the conjugate gradient algorithm.
